_olotro_: Day 8: Ulrich Olotro reached R-S16 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Ulrich Olotro and Teodor Shadowizard carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.

Dawn watch. Ulrich Olotro put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Arno "Doc" Jameson, badly wounded. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ulrich Olotro could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Ulrich Olotro won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in R-S16. The lance corporal wants a rematch. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ulrich Olotro is number 584. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-S16 changed before the cheering ended. Ulrich Olotro shouldered another load.
beniiioz: Albin "Parson" Beniiioz unpacked a stub of a pencil at R-R17. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Albin "Parson" Beniiioz before dusk. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin "Parson" Beniiioz made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking. A letter from home reached Albin "Parson" Beniiioz before dusk. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz read it twice and slept a little easier. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 999. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Albin "Parson" Beniiioz helped stack spare sandbags at R-R17. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
d1etpepsic0la11: The new runner is Isidor "Button" Etpepsic, once a stonemason from Old Harrow. The corporal asked if a stonemason was any use in a trench. Isidor "Button" Etpepsic said he would find out.

Isidor "Button" Etpepsic (Concord) watched Wendel "Mud" Zno (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Calvary Farm, and held fire until both were gone. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Isidor "Button" Etpepsic wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
denv04: The quartermaster asked Quentin "Hollow" Denv to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Quentin "Hollow" Denv aimed just below it. Henrik Chrisgghill was badly wounded. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Quentin "Hollow" Denv read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
frvr_midnight: The sergeant gave Gideon "Doc" Midnight a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Gideon "Doc" Midnight listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Gideon "Doc" Midnight fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Norbert Bob was grazed. Victory at Grey Mill. Gideon "Doc" Midnight let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
im_tried_bro: Felix Bro arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in Q-F23 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Felix Bro (Hegemony) watched Marek Zilyox (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Chalk Pits, and held fire until both were gone. Victory at Grey Mill. Felix Bro let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
jason_birdy27: Emil Birdy came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-R1 with the rations. Emil Birdy ate while listening to the revised orders.

The bread had frozen at the edges. Emil Birdy held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows. Grey Mill is lost. Emil Birdy heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
just_a_second_ago: On Day 11, Konrad Ago arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Konrad Ago shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
littlerattae: Day 9: Karel Littlerattae reached Q-F20 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached Q-F20 with the rations. Karel Littlerattae ate while listening to the revised orders.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Karel Littlerattae waited for that to change. When it did, Arno Larpinhimer was grazed. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Karel Littlerattae read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
matho_461: Day 11. The corporal put Marek "Lucky" Matho beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
micheal.evans09: Leopold Evans came up the line with a pocket Bible with a hole in it and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Isidor "Saint" Michael fell asleep on watch. Leopold Evans took over without waking Saint, and told the sergeant nothing. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In U-F19, Leopold Evans listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
red05052: Marek Red left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Coldwater and came up the line with a book with the last pages torn out. The men noticed at once that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.

Marek Red (Concord) and Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Calvary Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. Verdel Ridge has been won. Marek Red listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Marek Red raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F16. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Gideon Allistofeari of the Hegemony (@allistofearisgod).
The medics cleaned Marek Red's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F16.

Marek Red borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. Hill 304 is lost. Marek Red heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Marek Red in the open at R-F16. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies). The bearers reached Marek Red at R-F16 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies).
Rafael "Hollow" Red asked about Marek Red on arriving at R-F16. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Rafael "Hollow" Red found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Rafael "Hollow" Red took the long way round Calvary Farm because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two.

Rafael "Hollow" Red took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-F16, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies).

Rafael "Hollow" Red was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Rafael "Hollow" Red looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The stretcher Rafael "Hollow" Red lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Rafael "Hollow" Red is back at R-F16, and someone else is lying in that dent now. Rafael "Hollow" Red got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 143. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Rafael "Hollow" Red wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
sus.danny2.0: Day 3. The corporal put Quentin "Shadow" Danny beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Quentin "Shadow" Danny raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F18. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Severin Lagbagdotzip of the Hegemony (@lagbagdotzip). Quentin "Shadow" Danny fired at a movement across the wire at R-F18. The man went down: Lucien Jewnipers, gravely wounded.

Quentin "Shadow" Danny no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet went through Quentin "Shadow" Danny's sleeve at R-F18 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies). Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Quentin "Shadow" Danny watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Quentin "Shadow" Danny is whole again, or near enough for the line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Quentin "Shadow" Danny had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll crossed it, Quentin "Shadow" Danny fired. Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll was gravely wounded.

Across the wire at Hill 304, Cyril Rotten of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Quentin "Shadow" Danny of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.' Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Quentin "Shadow" Danny tried to remember the price of a loaf in Esterhaus. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.

Quentin "Shadow" Danny reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F18 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Edmund "Saint" Nazareth of the Hegemony (@nazareth_2bc). The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Quentin "Shadow" Danny looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medic looked at Quentin "Shadow" Danny's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F18. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin "Shadow" Danny is number 204. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Quentin "Shadow" Danny watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
the_real_brennan_ware: Norbert Ware reached T-F2 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Listening post, three in the morning. Norbert Ware heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. A letter from home reached Norbert Ware before dusk. Norbert Ware read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill has been won. Norbert Ware listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
twenskyyy: Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy came up with a draft of replacements on Day 4. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy thought about an old father who runs the family shop alone on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.

During a lull at the Chalk Pits, Nils Photo called across from the Concord line. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
The cook borrowed Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko and Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Jonas "Doc" Angelogia taught Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 319. The men who came later will ask about it. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
